case_title: State of Maharashtra vs. Rajeev Sharma & Ors.
bench: Bench of Hon'ble Mr. Justice D.Y. Chandrachud, Hon'ble Mr. Justice B.R. Gavai
summary: The Supreme Court examined the transition between IPC 302 and BNS 103, establishing that procedural protections under BNSS Section 173 (Zero FIR) apply retrospectively to ongoing investigative protocols where electronic evidence integrity under BSA Section 61 is satisfied.
ratio_decidendi: Electronic records produced under Section 61 of BSA 2023 carry primary evidentiary status provided authentication certificates meet statutory requirements.
disposition: Police custody order modified; direction issued for digital evidence preservation.

case_title: Priya Ananthakrishnan vs. Union of India
bench: Bench of Hon'ble Mrs. Justice B.V. Nagarathna, Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Karol
summary: Landmark ruling clarifying the constitutionality and scope of Section 69 of BNS 2023 regarding deceitful promise of marriage, underscoring the distinction between fraudulent inception of relationship versus genuine breach of intent.
ratio_decidendi: For an offence under Section 69 BNS to be sustained, the prosecution must establish fraudulent intent right at the inception of the relationship.

case_title: TechSolutions Pvt Ltd vs. Commissioner of Income Tax & Anr.
bench: Bench of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Rajiv Shakdher, Hon'ble Ms. Justice Tara Vitasta Ganju
summary: High Court examined cyber security corporate liability and digital transaction disclosures for IT entities operating multi-tier payment gateways.
ratio_decidendi: Corporate entities maintaining user data must adhere strictly to CERT-In cybersecurity directives and ISO standards.
disposition: Compliance window granted to petitioner company.
